summary: A generative firmware, FORMALFRED, that plays four lanes of rhythm and melody on its own, with its sequencer, voices and effects written in Lean 4 and backed by machine-checked proofs.
features: Four lanes: Euclidean, cellular automaton or ratchet rhythms
Eleven note sources incl. Markov, grammar, Turing and chord
Voices: 48 Braids shapes, a 4-op FM voice, ten 808 drums
Chord progressions and Tonnetz walks; scale lock and key
Hold-to-play 'PUNCH' effects; 142 factory and 8 user patches
MIDI in and out, internal or external clock
